video_caption: A bearded man wearing a black baseball cap and a black hoodie sits on a black leather couch in a room with green-lit walls, shelves of books, a plant, and a YouTube play button award in the background. He initially looks down, then directly at the camera, speaking animatedly and gesturing with his hands. A brief interlude shows a static TV test pattern before the man reappears, continuing to speak with increasing energy, and the semi-transparent words "STAR" and "TIKTOK" appear over his image. He mentions Salman Khan, and the word "SALMAN" overlays a blurry image of a man (presumably Salman Khan) scratching his head. The speaker then introduces Sana Khan, and the words "SANA" and "KHAN" overlay a close-up image of a woman wearing a plaid pink and white hijab looking at the camera. Following this, a short clip of a blurry concert crowd with bright stage lights plays, after which the man returns, speaking emphatically and making gestures with his hands, including pointing upwards. He refers to an Instagram post by "sanakhhaan21" which is displayed as a screenshot. The post, written in English, discusses her realization that the real purpose of life is not to chase wealth and fame but to serve humanity and follow her Creator's commands, announcing her decision to leave the Showbiz (Film Industry) lifestyle. The post has been liked by "muftimenkoffofficial and 303,711 others". The man then concludes his statement with further animated gestures and an upward pointed finger.

The video segment opens with a man, wearing a black baseball cap, glasses with red frames, a black jacket, and a white undershirt, sitting on a dark couch. He has a dark beard and mustache, and speaks directly to the camera, gesturing with his hands and pointing his index finger upwards at 0:05. Behind him, a blue wall is illuminated by green lighting, with bookshelves on the left and a plant, and a white YouTube play button award on the right. A black microphone is visible in front of him. At 0:09, the scene transitions to a woman wearing a light yellow hijab and a green top with sparkly silver embellishments on the shoulder, speaking directly to the camera with a serious expression. English subtitles appear on screen, translating her words: "SO WE SHOULD ENDEAVOR TO PRAY OF ALL OF OUR SALAAHS AND ON TIME, SO WE CAN ATTAIN ITS BLESSINGS AND VIRTUES." The video then transitions to an animated sequence on a black background; at 0:16, a small, bright spark appears and explodes into a golden, shattered cloud, which then reforms into a white speech bubble containing the golden text "SMILE TO JANNAH." The speech bubble dissipates into a shower of sparks, and at 0:20, the glowing orange text "BEING REAL IN A FAKE WORLD" appears, underlined by a yellow and orange line.

The video opens with a man, sporting a black beard, glasses, and wearing a black cap and a black zipped-up top, speaking directly to the camera. He sits on a dark couch against a light blue wall, with shelves of books and a green plant visible in the background. A microphone is positioned in front of him as he gestures emphatically with both hands, then raises one, and later moves both hands apart, conveying a serious and intense expression. He says, "We're gonna do what Rafiki from Lion King asked us to do, which is..." The scene then transitions to an animated clip from "The Lion King," showing Rafiki, a baboon with blue, red, and white face markings, holding Simba's head and then pointing forward. Simba, a male lion with a red mane, looks distressed. English text appears on screen, stating: "Look harder." The video then cuts back to the man, who is now holding up two fingers, then brings his fists to his chest and slightly opens them, emphasizing his words as he says, "Two very important ayahs should be held very close and dear to us, because they will..." before the video ends.

A man with a dark beard and glasses, wearing a black cap, black hoodie, and black jacket, sits on a black leather sofa, speaking directly to the camera. He gestures emphatically with his hands, at one point spreading them wide to emphasize a point and later making smaller gestures. A silver microphone with a black foam cover is positioned in front of him. The background features light blue walls with vertical green LED strip lighting, and shelves displaying books and a YouTube play button plaque. From 0:00 to 0:14, a white text box is superimposed on the left side of the screen, displaying Arabic text: وَمَنْ أَعْرَضَ عَن ذِكْرِى فَإِنَّ لَهُۥ مَعِيشَةً ضَنكًا وَنَحْشُرُهُۥ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ أَعْمَىٰ (meaning: "And whoever turns away from My remembrance - indeed, he will have a depressed life, and We will gather him on the Day of Resurrection blind."), identified as part of Sahih International. The text box disappears at 0:14.

The video opens with a man in a light blue shirt and brown pants pushing a broken-down blue hatchback car through a grassy field, with trees and a bright sunset/sunrise in the background, implying the car has no power. This transitions to a man with a beard and glasses, wearing a black cap and black hoodie, sitting on a black couch in an indoor setting with green and blue walls and bookshelves, speaking into a microphone and gesturing, comparing a car's need for fuel to something else. The next shot shows a close-up of a person's hand in a cream-colored sweater opening a car's fuel cap and inserting a red fuel nozzle into a gray car, further illustrating the concept of fuel. The speaker reappears, continuing his passionate address about fuel, and then a white text box appears on the left side of the screen, displaying an Arabic verse from the Quran (13:28): "الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَتَطْمَئِنُّ قُلُوبُهُم بِذِكْرِ اللَّهِ ۗ أَلَا بِذِكْرِ اللَّهِ تَطْمَئِنُّ الْقُلُوبُ" which translates to (SAHIH INTERNATIONAL: "Those who have believed and whose hearts are assured by the remembrance of Allah. Unquestionably, by the remembrance of Allah hearts are assured."), as he continues to speak emphatically. The video concludes with a serene shot of two women in hijabs embracing; one woman in a green and white floral hijab is hugging another woman in a red and white floral hijab, who has her eyes closed, conveying a sense of peace and assurance.

The video begins with a close-up of two women; one, wearing a green and white floral hijab, smiles at the camera while leaning her head on the shoulder of another woman, who wears a red and white patterned garment and has her eyes closed in apparent rest. This shifts to a dark scene illuminated by blue lights, showing a white stretch limousine with people on either side, one filming with a camera and headphones, others holding white papers. The next shot is an overhead view of a red carpet event, with a crowd of paparazzi-like individuals holding cameras, flashes going off, surrounding a section of the carpet where only a person's lower legs and high-heeled shoes are visible. Subsequently, two men are seen indoors, one in a light sweater and the other in a dark blue shirt, laughing and high-fiving each other in front of a framed city artwork. The scene then transitions to a man with a beard, glasses, black baseball cap, and black hoodie, sitting on a black leather couch and speaking into a microphone. The background features bookshelves, a green plant, and a YouTube play button plaque, all under a green light. A text overlay appears on the left, an article from "INDEPENDENT" titled "In most of us, by the age of thirty, the character has set like plaster, and will never soften again," discussing how personality is thought to become stable after adolescence and early twenties, making it difficult for a person to change after the age of 30. The man gestures with his hands, making a peace sign, as he continues to speak about change, before the video ends on a minimalist white background with faint diagonal lines and small green circles and crosses.

A bearded man wearing a black cap, glasses, and a black hoodie sits on a dark leather sofa, speaking into a black microphone. The background features a light green wall, shelves with books, and a plant. From 00:07 to 00:10, his face becomes humorously distorted, stretched, and slightly blurred with a green tint, while he continues to speak. He then returns to his normal appearance, speaking and gesturing. At 00:18, the scene changes to a close-up of a black analog alarm clock on a bedside table in a dimly lit, blue-tinted room. A hand reaches in to press the snooze button on the clock's top. The video then cuts back to the man, who continues to speak into the microphone from his sofa.

The video opens with a bearded man wearing glasses, a black cap, and a black jacket, speaking animatedly into a black microphone. He sits on a black leather couch, gesturing with both hands, against a background of a blue wall with green ambient lighting, shelves with books and electronics, and a white YouTube logo cutout. The scene then transitions to a man in a dark suit standing on a sandy beach at dawn or dusk, looking out at the calm ocean with his hands in his pockets. This is followed by a close-up shot of a tear rolling down a person's cheek, indicating sadness. Finally, the video cuts back to the original man in the black cap, continuing to speak into the microphone from his earlier position on the couch.

The video opens with a man, wearing a black cap, glasses, and a black beard, speaking into a microphone while sitting on a dark leather couch. He is wearing a black hoodie, and the background features a blue wall with shelves displaying books and plants, illuminated by green lights. The scene then cuts to a still image of a man with short, styled dark hair and a slight beard, wearing a black quilted leather jacket, looking directly at the camera. The video returns to the first man speaking, who gestures with his hands as he talks. A split-screen then appears, showing two blurry figures, one on the left in a yellow shirt and another on the right with long hair, while a black text bar displays: "I WASN'T LOSING SLEEP BECAUSE I LOST SOME GEM OF A MAN. BUT TO THINK HOW SILLY I WAS. HOW SILLY! AND HOW I WASTED MYSELF, BY JOINING MY NAME WITH A DONKEY." The video switches back to the man on the couch, speaking with a serious expression, with the text overlay: "*ALLEGEDLY*". This is followed by a blurry image of three people, two women on either side and a third person in the middle, against a light brown wall, with a black text bar displaying: "AND I HAVE THIS PICTURES OF HE HITTING ME AND I HAD BROKEN MY HEAD AND THERE ARE BRUISES ON MY FACE WHICH I HAVE, I'LL SHOW YOU THE PICTURE POST THE INTERVIEW WHICH I'M STILL NOT POSTED." The man on the couch reappears, looking concerned and gesturing. Finally, a blurry split-screen of two individuals is shown again, with evolving text: "UNFORTUNATELY I WAS ON SLEEPING TABLETS. I WILL NOT RECOMMEND THAT TO ANYBODY", then "AND I THINK THE DAY I STOPPED IT WAS THE DAY MY MOM GOT TO KNOW ABOUT IT.", and lastly "THEN I STARTED YOU KNOW RECITING MORE AND MORE AND MORE AND THAT'S HOW I STARTED GETTING MORE SLEEP. AND I WAS LIKE aapko mene bola tha na ke mene life me kabhi nahi socha tha ke mein Allah se" (Didn't I tell you that, I never thought in my life I would be praying to sleep, from Allah).

The video opens with a man wearing a black cap, glasses, and a black bearded, speaking passionately into a microphone while sitting on a dark leather couch against a blue and green lit background with shelves of books and plants. This cuts to a blurred clip of two women sitting, seemingly in conversation, followed by a blurred close-up of one of the women, and then back to the two women, all against a warm orange background. The video returns to the man, still speaking and gesturing with his hands. A split-screen then appears, showing blurry images of a man in a yellow shirt on the left and a woman in a dark top on the right, with white text overlaying the bottom: "I AM IN THIS INDUSTRY AND I KNOW IT IS LIKE THIS EVERYTHING IS FAKE... I HAVE... BUT YOU DON'T KNOW WHAT THEIR PERSONAL LIFE IS AT HOME. LIKE AT LEAST I BEING A PART OF IT I KNOW LOT OF THINGS. HOW PEOPLE ARE LIKE LIVING THEIR OWN LIVES." (This text translates and describes what the woman is saying). The video concludes with the man speaking into the microphone, continuing to use hand gestures.

The video segment opens with two blurred video call frames displayed side-by-side against a vibrant orange and pink gradient background. The left frame shows a blurry man in a yellow top, and the right frame shows a blurry woman in a dark top. Text overlays appear at various points: "3 HOURS AT A TIME" (00:01), "VARIOUS PEOPLE. WOULD SPEAK" (00:02), "DAY AND NIGHT I WOULD SPEAK TO THEM" (00:04), "I COULDN'T SLEEP EVEN FOR ONE MINUTE. I CAN'T SLEEP" (00:06), and "EVEN AFTER PILLS I CAN'T SLEEP" (00:08), all conveying a struggle with sleep and constant conversation. From 00:09 to 00:15, the scene transitions to a clear shot of a man with a dark beard, wearing a black baseball cap, glasses, and a black hoodie, speaking into a microphone. He sits on a black leather couch, with a background featuring a blue wall, shelves filled with books and plants, and a white YouTube play button logo, illuminated by green lights. He appears to be commenting on the preceding segment. The video then cuts back to the two blurred video call frames from 00:15 to 00:35, with further text overlays: "उनका रिलेशनशिप टूटा" (Their relationship broke) translating to "YOUR RELATIONSHIP BROKE" (00:16), "और बहुत ही खराब तरीके से" (and quite badly) translating to "AND QUITE BADLY" (00:18). Then, a longer overlay appears: "But what I respect is आप डिप्रेशन के बारे में आपने बात की आपने दोस्तों से बात किया" (But what I respect is, you spoke about your depression, you spoke to your friends.) translating to "YOU SPOKE ABOUT YOUR DEPRESSION. YOU SPOKE TO YOUR FRIENDS." (00:20). The segment concludes with the male voice in the blurred frame continuing to speak, with the overlay "And today, you're in a position where you're talking about all these things from the heart, without doing anything wrong to yourself as well," highlighting the woman's journey of overcoming adversity and speaking openly about her struggles.

The video begins with a heavily blurred split-screen showing two individuals, a man in a yellow shirt on the left and a woman in a black top on the right, both facing forward in what appears to be a video call or interview setting, against a vibrant red and orange gradient background; blurry text is visible below each person. This blurred scene continues until 00:11, when it abruptly transitions to a clear split-screen. On the left side, a smartphone screen displays an Instagram post from "sanakhann21," featuring a lengthy text message that ends with "Thank you very much Sana Khan," and shows "Liked by muftimenkoffical and 303,711 others." On the right side, a bearded man wearing glasses and a black cap is actively speaking into a microphone, gesturing with his hands and displaying an animated expression, implying he is commenting on or reacting to the content shown on the left screen.

From 00:03 to 00:20, a man with a black beard, wearing a black baseball cap, black-rimmed glasses, and a black hoodie, is seen speaking directly to the camera while seated on a black couch. He gestures with his hands to emphasize his points. A black microphone on a stand is positioned in front of him. On the left side of the screen, an Instagram post by "sanakhaan21" is displayed, titled "Posts." The text of the post reads: "In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful Brothers and sisters! Today I am talking to you standing at a crucial juncture of my life. I have been living the Showbiz (Film Industry) life for years, and during this time I have been blessed with all kinds of fame, honour and wealth from my fans for which I am grateful to them. But for a few days now, I have been possessed of the realization that is the real purpose of man coming into this world only to chase wealth and fame? Isn't it a part of his/her duty to spend his/her life in the service of those who are needy and helpless? Shouldn't a person think that he/she could die at any moment? And what will happen to him after he/she is no more? I have been searching for answers to these two questions for a long period of time, especially the second question as to what will happen to me after my death? When I searched for the answer to this question in my religion, I realized that this life in the world is actually for the betterment of life after death. And it will be better if the slave lives according to the command of his Creator, and does not make wealth and fame his only goal; rather, he/she should avoid sinful life and serve humanity, and follow the path shown by his/her Creator. Therefore, I declare today that from today onwards, I have resolved to say goodbye to my Showbiz lifestyle forever and serve humanity and follow the orders of my Creator. All brothers and sisters are requested to pray for me to Allah to accept my repentance and grant me the true ability to live in accordance with my determination of spending my life following the commandments of my Creator and in the service of humanity, and grant me perseverance in it. Finally, all brothers and sisters are requested to not consult me with regards to any Showbiz work henceforth. Thank you very much Sana Khan." (The text is a public statement by Sana Khan about her decision to leave the entertainment industry and dedicate her life to religious and humanitarian pursuits, seeking prayers for her repentance and perseverance.) Below the text, it says, "Liked by muftimenkoffical and 303,711 others." The background behind the man features a blue wall with vibrant green lighting and shelves filled with items. From 00:20 to 00:22, the scene transitions to a long, narrow aisle between towering bookshelves filled with books, suggesting a library or archive. A bright window at the far end of the aisle illuminates the space, with a green plant visible on a small table near the window.

The video segment opens with a dark shot of bookshelves on the left, filled with books, gradually becoming fully black by 0:05. It then transitions to a man with a dark beard, wearing a black cap, glasses, and a black hooded jacket, speaking into a microphone. He gestures with his hands, sitting on a dark sofa against a bright, light green wall decorated with shelves of books, plants, and what looks like a YouTube Play Button award. At 0:19, the scene changes to a close-up profile of a young man with short, light brown hair, wearing a cream turtleneck sweater and a dark coat, seated in a car and gazing pensively out the window, occasionally raising his right hand in a subtle gesture. The background outside is blurred with bare trees. The video cuts back to the first man at 0:33, who is now pointing both index fingers at his temples, emphasizing a thought, before lowering his hands again.

The video segment opens with a man wearing a black baseball cap, glasses, and a black hoodie, speaking into a microphone while gesturing with his hands. He has a dark beard and is seated on a black leather couch, with shelves of books and green-lit walls in the blurred background. The scene then transitions to a close-up profile of a young man with light skin, gazing intently into the distance with a contemplative expression, his fingers resting near his mouth, against a soft-focus background of trees and a pale sky. Next, a Black man with short, dark hair and a beard is shown in profile, sitting in a brown leather armchair, looking away thoughtfully with a slightly pensive expression, against a light-colored, textured wall. Finally, the video shows the back of a man with grey hair, wearing a dark suit jacket, standing by a body of water and looking towards a bright, golden sunset reflecting on the water's surface.

A bearded man with glasses, wearing a black cap and a black hooded jacket, sits on a dark sofa and speaks directly to the camera. He gestures with his hands frequently and occasionally smiles, displaying an engaging and expressive demeanor. At the beginning of the clip, he briefly scratches the top of his head. A black microphone is positioned in front of him. The background features a wall lit with a bright green light, creating a vibrant glow. On either side, shelves are visible, adorned with books and other items, including a white YouTube play button trophy on the right side.

The video opens with a man sitting on a dark leather couch, wearing a black baseball cap, clear-framed glasses, and a black hooded jacket. He has a dark beard and mustache and speaks directly into a black microphone on a stand in front of him. The background features a blue wall illuminated by two green-glowing light panels, with shelves on either side holding books and decorative items, including a YouTube play button plaque. As he speaks, he uses expressive hand gestures, initially with open palms, then raising his hands slightly as if in prayer or supplication, and later pointing upwards with a slight smile. His expressions convey earnestness and sincerity throughout his speech. At 0:47, the video abruptly transitions to a bright white outro screen. On the top left, the word "SUBSCRIBE!" is written diagonally in black text. Below it are social media icons and handles: "f SMILE2JANNAH", "O SMILE2JANNAH", and "SMILE2JANNAH1". A circular animation with a spinning arrow is at the bottom left. In the center, a large blank white rectangle is labeled "WATCH ANOTHER VIDEO!", followed by "1,000,000 views" and YouTube-style interaction buttons (like, dislike, share, save). Below this is the channel name "Smile 2 Jannah" with a cloud emoji and "166K subscribers". Further text provides details about the "NEW Smile2Jannah store" selling "exclusive T-shirts, sweatshirts and mugs" at "http://Smile2Jannah.com", and encourages viewers to "Like | Subscribe | Share | Comment" to "help us a great deal. Jazakallahu Khairun." (May Allah reward you with goodness). It also lists social media links for Facebook, Instagram, and Twitter. On the right side of the screen, a vertical banner reads "SMILE2JANNAH.COM" and displays a column of merchandise: two white t-shirts with yellow cartoon designs (one saying "WANNA JANNAH" and another "KEEP CALM DON'T CAUSE" with an Arabic 'seen' for 'sin'), two white mugs with Arabic letters ('waaw' and 'meem'), a white t-shirt with a red shield logo and "I GOT JANNAH", another white t-shirt with a cartoon graphic, and a white long-sleeved shirt.
